text:
pagerduty: INC-2026-045 triggered — High error-rate (5xx) on inference-gateway-eu. PD link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-045 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: auto-summary: 5xx spike started 02:13 UTC, current 4.2x baseline. Codes: 502 ~70%, 504 ~20%. Top routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Region: eu-west1. Probable upstream: auth-proxy (timeouts).
alice: acked — I'm oncall. tagging SRE. Any quick customer impact notes?
ben: looking now. auth-proxy CPU ~90% on several pods, logs show repeated "upstream read timeout" and 502s. No obvious network flapping.
dave: on call too. I'll try a rolling restart on auth-proxy canary subset (eu-west1).
carla: support: 3 customer complaints in last 10m (tickets #EU-1234, #EU-1235, #EU-1236). All report 502s for generation requests. Escalated to high-touch.
ben: quick debug snippet:
```
# tail recent logs
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/auth-proxy -l region=eu-west1 --since=10m | grep -i timeout | tail -n 5
"ERROR upstream read timeout after 30s"
"WARN request aborted: 502 upstream"
```
ben: also seeing increased latency to token-introspect service (~1200ms avg).
alice: plan: 1) scale auth-proxy +2 replicas, 2) restart canary pods, 3) route small % away if needed. Ben, can you run scale? Dave, do restart. Carla — send a short customer update.
ben: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/auth-proxy -n prod --replicas=5` :white_check_mark:
dave: restarting canary pods (rolling, 1 at a time). logs: pod auth-proxy-7b9 restarted, pod became ready in ~45s. restarted second pod now.
carla: customer update drafted:
"Hey — we’re investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting inference in EU. Engineers are mitigating; we’ll update in 15 minutes. If you see ongoing errors, please reply with request IDs. — Redwood Support" :email:
alice: enabling temporary route-weight diversion: 10% traffic to fallback-variant in eu-west1 via router API:
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/route/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west1","route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"primary":0.9,"fallback":0.1}}'
```
ben: after scale/restarts CPU down to ~66%, error-rate dropping to ~1.4x baseline. 502s reduced, 504s stable. telemetry shows p50/p95 improving.
dave: one restarted pod had OOMKill earlier (investigating memory footprint), but new replica healthy. Might need an image bump or config tweak later.
incident-bot: alert state: incident still open. auto-suppression will evaluate - if 5xx stays <1.5x baseline for 30m it will auto-close.
alice: good progress. setting 10m check-ins. If stable at +30m we close. Ben — please follow up on token-introspect latency root cause.
carla: posted customer updates to the three tickets, added workaround note.
ben: acknowledged. I'll post a short follow-up in 10. :thumbsup:
alice: thanks team :pray: — keeping on watch.
incident-bot: note: PD escalation schedule unaffected. Next oncall (europe) will be paged on re-escalation.
